purpose: Mixed real-world replay pack with symmetric shaping pressure: noisy prune cases, one weaker-signaled explore case, and less direct terrain wording in the visible layer.

cases.title: Reconciliation looked fixed until the follow-up check drifted again
cases.symptom: A reconcile flow reported progress after an automatic repair step, but a later verification pass still showed state drift.
visible_evidence: The same workflow both mutates data and verifies it again later
An early success signal is available before the final settled state is known
The wrong move is to treat first-pass progress as full convergence

starting_context.repro_style: workflow repair followed by later verification under noisy state

replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: treat first apparent repair as final success

success_criteria: identify why early progress did not guarantee the settled final state
propose a fix family consistent with the landed repair plus later verification changes

cases.title: Approval returned 200 but still could not be trusted
cases.symptom: An approval request returned HTTP 200, yet the flow still could not safely be interpreted as a real approval.
visible_evidence: Transport success and contract success are not the same thing here
The response can look healthy while still lacking the signal needed to treat the operation as approved
The safe fix depends on how the result is interpreted, not just whether a request returned

misleading_telemetry: payload omits a strong explicit approval signal
replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: treat any successful HTTP response as approval

success_criteria: identify why a nominally successful response still required fail-closed handling
propose a fix family consistent with the landed contract-safe interpretation change

cases.title: Allowance rollover looked fine until later refresh activity
cases.symptom: Rollover behavior seemed fine in the immediate flow, but later refresh and publisher activity left allowances wrong again.
visible_evidence: The visible break happens after later state movement, not only at the first allowance calculation
More than one surface participates in carrying the state forward
A local arithmetic fix would be plausible but incomplete

starting_context.repro_style: later state drift after refresh and downstream updates

replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: patch only the immediate rollover math

success_criteria: identify why later state changes re-broke the rollover behavior
propose a fix family consistent with the landed multi-surface patch

cases.title: Campaign summary report sometimes came back incomplete
cases.symptom: A campaign summary flow sometimes returned incomplete or empty results even though the request path itself did not fully fail.
visible_evidence: The result depended on how campaign and partner context were assembled before the remote call
Different caller paths could reach the same summary operation with different available context
The failure did not look like a single bad field so much as a missing or misrouted setup step

starting_context.repro_style: incomplete summary output depending on request context

success_criteria: identify why summary generation depended on upstream context assembly rather than one isolated field fix
match the landed fix family across summary flow and handler fallback logic
cases.notes: Weaker-signaled explore case with less explicit ambiguity shaping.

cases.title: Allowance refresh logs looked normal but limits stayed stale
cases.symptom: A background refresh appeared to run, but the expected allowance recovery still did not happen.
visible_evidence: Task logs suggested the refresh path executed
The symptom creates a temptation to broaden into publisher or client state tracking
The eventual fix was still localized to the refresh step rather than a broad propagation rewrite

starting_context.repro_style: background refresh looked healthy while one narrow step stayed wrong

replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: broaden into full state propagation audit

success_criteria: find why the refresh step still failed to restore the expected allowance state
align with the landed localized task-level fix direction

cases.title: Refresh sometimes reset publisher state unexpectedly
cases.symptom: A refresh path sometimes reset publisher-related state even though nearby data writes appeared to succeed.
visible_evidence: The visible break feels like a stale-state problem at first glance
It only reproduces when refresh behavior touches one publisher update path
A broad cross-system search is tempting, but the landed fix stayed compact

starting_context.repro_style: state reset during refresh on one compact publisher path

misleading_telemetry: manual publisher edits looked stable before refresh
refresh symptom appears after a seemingly unrelated update call
replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: search across all refresh sequencing surfaces

success_criteria: identify the narrow publisher update condition that allowed refresh to reset state
match the landed compact publisher-surface fix family

cases.title: Report counts were wrong even though upstream data existed
cases.symptom: A handler returned wrong counts and collections even though upstream responses were not empty.
visible_evidence: The request completed and returned data, but local output fields still came back wrong
This can look like a broader upstream inconsistency because the raw response is not blank
The landed fix still stayed in the local response handling layer

starting_context.repro_style: returned data present but local output fields still wrong

misleading_telemetry: transport and auth surfaces looked healthy

success_criteria: identify the local response-handling mismatch that produced wrong counts and collections
match the landed handler-layer fix direction
cases.notes: Prune-deserving mapping case with distracting noise.

cases.title: Gateway returned 401 even though credentials looked valid
cases.symptom: A gateway auth flow returned 401 despite credentials that appeared valid in nearby checks.
visible_evidence: Most auth assumptions point toward credential debugging first
Only one lookup route was consistently wrong while the rest of the auth setup looked normal
The landed fix stayed narrow even though the surface symptom looked broad

starting_context.repro_style: auth failure caused by one narrow route construction bug

misleading_telemetry: error surface presents as 401 auth failure
replay_augmentation.false_positive_fix_family: broaden into credential or secret-rotation debugging

success_criteria: identify the narrow gateway lookup-path bug behind the auth failure surface
match the landed fix family in the auth boundary
